notes.title: Patch 0.9.5.5
notes.notes:
In this patch, we're experimenting with new patterns for added garbage lines to help increase the pace of the game.  They're intended to be a bit harder to clear than before, but with more blocks to clear in them to increase the overall number of lines sent in a game.  The result is an increase in effectiveness for horizontal explosions, which rewards skill.

[h1]Game System Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] New patterns for added lines.
[/list]
[h1]UI Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] New indicator that shows where your board height will be after line adds, or your current board height if there's no lines to add.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Misc. animation bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5.4 - More AI updates
notes.notes:
Similar to last week's patch, this is a minor update with improvements to the AI of the rest of the cast, some UI improvements and bug fixes. We've also added a feature to display each character's move list by pausing the game or by a new 'show moves' button.  While it's set by default for new players, returning players will need to assign the button manually in Options.

Going forward, we plan to continue to release minor updates and fixes as we focus on finishing up the rest of the game.

[*] Improved AI for Pone, Leon, Harland, Luna, and Rafael

[h1]UI Improvements[/h1]
[list]

[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Versus Mode - players were unable to cancel out of their selection in the Character Select Screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5.0
notes.notes:
In order to lessen the mental load on players, shape difficulty has been toned down.  In exchange, we've introduced a new type of block, which in essence, is a "double block".  These blocks need to be cleared twice, but maintains the same color once the first stage is cleared.  The "brick-blocks" have also been changed as the clearing mechanics for those are a little too confusing, again adding to the complexity problem.  Of course, these are radical changes so look forward to some balance changes in the next few patches.

[h1]Game System Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] A new block type that requires clearing twice has been added, dubbed the "double block"
[*] Play Pieces now occasionally spawn with double blocks
[*] Panic mode increases the rate of double block spawns
[*] Brick blocks only require clearing once by proximity now, as opposed to twice.  As such, it also falls naturally without staying stuck
[*] We've added difficulty settings to the story mode, which will receive more tuning in the coming patches
[/list]
[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Pone's "1000 Shattering Fists" has swapped to level 4 and now uses the new Brick Blocks, with a fixed pattern
[*] Pone's "Sky Splitter" has swapped to level 3
[*] Harland's "Tweets of the Afterlife" now uses the new Brick Blocks
[*] Joseph's "Brickinator" now uses the new Brick Blocks
[*] Setter Z's "Burst Hurricane" has been changed to push the top of his blocks to the opponent's board
[*] Leon's "Slash Slash" has been changed to add double blocks instead of bricks
[/list]
[h1]Known Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Board blocks may animate incorrectly some of the time
[/list]

notes.title: Christmas Colors Patch 0.9.4.4
notes.notes:
Based on the feedback and testing from our Discord channel, we are increasing the number of colors in blocks back from 3 to 4.  This change should help increase the viability of chain setups by reducing the chance of accidental clears.  This version was first made available to our experimental game build, which can be accessed in the Steam Properties page of Spaera.  Moving forward, we will be making changes quickly on the experimental build to get feedback.  If you would like to be a part of this process, please join the Discord and have some discourse!  

[h1]Game System Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] There are now four potential block colors that can show up in pieces. 
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed misc. bugs that were causing crashes.
[*] Fixed personal leaderboards not displaying records properly
[/list]

[h1]UI Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated the UI for Online Mode selection to match Story Mode UI.
[/list]

notes.title: Tutorial and Pacing Patch - 0.9.4.3
notes.notes:
We are introducing a tutorial mode that goes over the very basics of the game with this patch.  While this probably won't be very useful for most of you who are reading this and are already experts at the game, this hopefully will help ease new players into the game.  The mode is currently located under Story mode if you wish to check it out, and we'd greatly appreciate any feedback!  As for a more advanced tutorial, that is something we hope to work on at a later date.

[h1]Game System Changes[/h1]

One of the feedbacks we've been receiving lately is that the Chain Multiplier mechanic feels more like a distraction and the game would be better off without it.  

When we added the Chain Multiplier, it was done in hopes to change large clear setup playstyle from high risk low rewards, to at least high risk high rewards.  In Spaera, setups are innately high risk due to the potential threat of opponents' abilities that can wipe away your hard work.  Chain Multipliers are supposed to make them more gratifying if someone does decide and manages to pull off a successful setup. 

However, that doesn't mean that players should feel like they are punished if they aren't doing chains.  We are currently entertaining the thought of removing Chain Multipliers completely, we wanted to try one tweak and also hear your feedback.
[list]
[*] Decreased the number of block clears required to send a line to the opponent from 7 to 6.
[*] 1 chain and 2 chains now share the same multiplier.
[/list]
Now players are guaranteed to send at least one line every two clears even without chains.  This should help end game survival as well as increase the pace of the game.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.4.2
notes.notes:
In this patch, we are exploring certain system changes to increase the pace of the game, and the frequency of magic abilities used.  

We have been busy restructuring our server architecture to improve stability and better prepare us for upcoming features.  While there is still a good amount of work left, we are working towards enabling private match lobbies to support more than 2 players, and spectator mode.

[h1]Game System Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Increased frequency of pieces containing magic orbs
[*] Changed board to start with 6 rows of garbage blocks
[*] [b]Panic Mode[/b] multiplier is now 1.5x when in Panic Mode.     
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing certain assets to display in lower resolutions than intended.
[*] Fixed misc animation glitches.
[/list]


[h1][u]Previous Patch Notes[/u][/h1]
Since we somehow managed to post the previous patch notes on every place except on Steam, here's the missing patch notes for 0.9.4.0:

Hello All!  Today's patch covers mostly quality of life updates and bug fixes surrounding the UI and game animations.  The most visible change is the addition of the Drop Shadow, which makes it a lot easier to plan your combos.  We know this has been a highly requested feature and we got around to adding it in!  We've also tweaked some spells here and there.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Harland's [b]Orb Eater[/b] only takes away exactly one meter, leaving partial meters alone.
[*] Harland's [b]Tweets of the Afterlife[/b] has new Pixel Arts!
[*] Joseph's [b]Raging Waters[/b] now has a 2x bonus per orb stolen
[/list]
[h1]UI Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Drop Shadow added to current play piece
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed some Leon spell animation glitches
[*] Fixed some animation glitches for Pone's [b]Lava Geyser[/b]
[*] Fixed [b]Personal leaderboards[/b].  They are now functional again
[*] Fixed some layer issues with some spells
[/list]

notes.title: Leon Patch 0.9.3.4
notes.notes:
Today we are re-introducing the 8th playable character for the initial version of Spaera, [b]Leon[/b].  As many of you might recognize him from our initial Beta, Leon has been placed on the sidelines since the huge system change last year.  With the game system finally stabilizing with perhaps a few tweaks left, we'd like to push out the current iteration of Leon for you to try.

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147106/034db92165eb4fa65adcc27f55aebcf358c247bb.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147106/9e78742c8679c166d1fbb5bc7c1a457f479837ae.jpg[/img][/url]

Leon retains his counterpunch style of play, but now with a bit more offense.  His Level 4, Thrust of 9000+, has been his signature move, and we made it a focus to keep it as faithful as possible.  

His level 3, Kogoro Stance, has been replaced with an Offense move, Slash Slash.  Slash Slash adds two slashes of bricks to the opponent's board.

[h1]Leon's Spells[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Slothy Guard Stance[/b] 
For each of the next 2 pieces, stops up to 5 lines from being added to your board.

[*] [b]Swift My Sword[/b]
Removes the top 3 lines of your board.

[*] [b]Slash Slash[/b]
Adds two slashes of bricks to the top of the opponent's board.

[*] [b]Thrust of 9000+[/b]  
For 2 pieces, any clear will trigger all blocks to cascade downwards if there is empty space.  When active, this will prevent magic orbs and exploder blocks from dropping.

[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Rafael's [b]Lingering Intermezzo[/b] Duration Reduced from [b]5[/b] turns to [b]4[/b]
[/list]
[h1]UI Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Panic Mode text now has transparency for better visibility
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Memory Allocation Performance has been greatly improved
[*] Misc Crash fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.9.3.3
notes.notes:
With the previous change to orbs, the concern was that meter gain is too bursty and inconsistent.  We like how orb clearing is consistent with the behavior of other colors, but we agree that unless the player is proficient at using explosions to clear single orbs, it was difficult to clear them.  The main changes in this patch are to reduce the amount of meter acquired via clearing an orb, and increase the number of orbs that appear in an orb piece. 

Here are the patch notes:

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]One meter is gained for clearing every 3 orbs.
[*]2 orbs instead of 1 orb are in every piece that contains orbs.
[*]Leftover meter now stays on magic usage.  Ex. Using magic when you have 1.5 meter will now leave you with 0.5 meter.
[/list]

[h1]UI Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the looks of the blocks.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Misc. Animation bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.9.3.2
notes.notes:
For this patch, we've made some tweaks to the multiplier formula.  In particular, we've made the multiplier a bit more mild and capped after reaching a certain number of chains.  The other change was to reduce the number of lines required to send a line from 12 to 7.  The main goal with this change is to increase the power of regular clears and improve end-game survivability as players near the top are more likely to rely on single clears rather than chains.

Here are the patch notes:

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Multiplier power is reduced, and does not increase after 4 chains.
[*]Number of blocks required to clear to send a line is reduced from 12 to 7.
[/list]

[h1]UI Changes[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147106/67ed31b0bbec94ca167aa848407a043ae316d6f2.png[/img]
[list]
[*]We are experimenting with a new look for our blocks.
[*]Added a visual indicator for partial orb meter gain by the orbs themselves.

[h1]What's Next[/h1]

Orb clearing has been a concern for us, and based on the feedback we are receiving, it appears that we are not alone.  We have some ideas we'd like to try, so stay tuned for our next patch.

notes.title: Spaera 2017 Refresh Patch
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147106/0c61c335d7b091f2e508db025db8df924bf25e4d.png[/img]

As previously we previously mused about, the big 2017 patch is here.  Some of the thoughts that went into the big changes in this patch can be found by clicking here: 

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487250/announcements/detail/484540733158436753]Part 1[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487250/announcements/detail/469905196807977240]Part 2[/url]

We are looking forward to discussing all the changes with you on discord!

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Overflowing Blocks on the top of the board are no longer cropped during a clear.  After cascading, if a block is still left overflowing on top, the player loses the match.
[*]Orb Clearing mechanics have been changed.  Magic orbs can now only match with each other as a match 3 color or they can be cleared via horizontal or vertical explosions.
[*]Normal playable blocks now come in only 3 colors.
[*]Off-color blocks only appear in specific spells such as Luna's "Luna Punishment" spell.
[*]Board dimensions changed to 21 by 10.
[*]Added a myriad of new pentaminos.
[*]Orb and Exploder spawn location rearranged on play pieces.
[*]Adjusted block clearing combo multiplier to be more aggressive.
[*]Garbage lines generated by each player's combos now cancel each other out before being applied.
[*]Timer till Panic Mode is increased from 150 to 200 seconds.
[*]Players start with an empty board now.
[/list]
[h1]Rebalancing[/h1]

Adjusted many spells to accommodate different board dimensions.

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]There are some performance issues in this build mainly due to an engine upgrade.
[*]There are some board glitches where the incorrect block will be displayed for a short period of time during cascading effects, brick magic and other parts of the game
[*]There are some UI layer issues littered throughout the game.

As previously we previously mused about, the big 2017 patch is here.  Some of the thoughts that went into the big changes in this patch can be found by clicking here:

notes.title: Happy New Years Patch - 0.9.2.13
notes.notes:
2016 has come close to an end, and we hope everyone has been enjoying the holiday season.  With upcoming features such as the tutorial, a training mode, finishing up the story mode, and game mechanics tweaks, 2017 is going to be a big year for us as we target getting Spaera to full release.

This patch is going to be the first of a series of game mechanics changes to address some issues and concerns we have to the current pacing and overall feel of the game.  Please be patient with us during the process, as the game will often be a bit broken in terms of character balance.  The main feedback we are looking for right now is your thoughts on whether the new mechanics look and feel fun. 

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[u]Chain Multipliers[/u]
Previously, while clearing and making fancy chains feel good, they have not been very rewarding.  In particular, they don't do anything more than doing multiple small, separate clears, yet take more time and thinking to set up.  

At the moment, a line is sent to the opponent for every 12 blocks you clear.  [b]Chain Multipliers[/b] increase the number of blocks counted by 0.5x for every additional chain.

For example, a 3-clear cascaded into a 8-clear, and then into an 11-clear would count as:

1 * 3 = 3
1.5 * 8 = 12
2 * 11 = 22

For a total of 37 blocks being counted, resulting in 3 lines for attacking.  Compared to the previous patch, this would've been counted as 22 blocks and only added 1 line to the opponent.

[u]Row Tweaks[/u]
One of the concerns we have is that matches are lasting too long when a player is at the top.  Even though we like having comeback potential in matches, we'd like to make them less frequent.  In order to do this, we are planning to tweak the patterns of lines added to opponents, and for this patch, we are making the patterns a bit more random as a start.

[u]UI Polishing and Minor Changes[/u]
We've brushed up some of the UIs and changed the wording on the text of [i]XX blocks cleared[/i] to [i]XX hits[/i] to represent how much damage the player is actually doing after multipliers.

We are looking to further tune our UI to make it more clear as to how many more blocks are needed to send a line, and what the exact multiplier is for a certain clear.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where the game crashes after playing a certain number of matches.
[*]Fixed bug where using a Rafael spell would sometimes make deck pieces disappear.
[*]Fixed clearing animation bugs involving Rafael's Skyward Cadenza.
[*]Fixed bug where acquiring an Orb via the Orb meter did not trigger an orb acquired sound effect.
[*]Fixed a bug where sending to a Private Match invite to a player on the Title Screen would put the inviter's game in a weird state that prevents the player from playing online.
[*]Misc. bug fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]

[*] [b][u]Non-English Steam Names are not showing up since international font isn't supported yet[/u][/b] 
There is currently a temporary fix to strip the foreign characters away from the name, but we do intend to support the display of foreign characters.

[*] [b][u]The Spaera Client still needs some performance tweaks.[/u][/b] 
While we've made improvements on performance, performance improvement is always something we feel we can do better.  If you are seeing performance issues and/or sluggishness, please let us know.

[*] [b][u]Panic text sometimes goes behind the board if it shows up during a magic spell.[/u][/b] 

[*] [b][u]There are still some unexpected graphical glitches here and there.[/u][/b] 
We fixed even more of them this patch, but if you still see any glitches, please report them.  We'd like to make sure we don't miss any of them!
[/list]

As always, if new bugs are found, Please report them to the Steam Spaera Discussion Page!  

[h1]And one more thing[/h1]
Keep an eye out for your orbs!  Rumor has it that a certain someone has begun to show up and snatch orbs from players!

[i]Thanks to @MrSmileAlot for the Tsubaki art![/i]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147106/b6c29fc87f6116afc6154cb87cb40fef025859bc.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 0.9.2.11
notes.notes:
Greetings!  

For this patch, our focus has been on bug fixes, tuning the clear animation, and laying down the foundation for a tutorial mode and possibly a training mode in the future.  We are aiming to get a simple tutorial mode up in the next few weeks to help welcome new players to the game.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
Single Player and Versus P1 controls have been merged. The original scheme has become cumbersome, and especially with the conflict checking between Single Player and Versus P1 controls. 

The original intent was to try to address the scenario where a player has a keyboard setup that uses the whole keyboard, but would likely use only a portion of the keyboard if it were to be shared in Versus play. Having separate settings would allow the player to play the two different modes without adjusting controls.

However, the implementation shouldn't have checked for conflicts between controls as mentioned above, and the player shouldn't need to rebind joysticks like what niconico said. So we are going to merge Single Player and Versus P1 controls back into just a Player 1 mapping.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where the music can momentarily stop in the middle of the game.
[*]Fixed bug where the music stops when two Rafaels both use Lingering Intermezzo.
[*]Fixed bug where the indicators for duration-based spells do not disappear if they were ended via an activation of another spell.
[*]Fixed animation bug where blocks drop incorrectly when a horizontal explosion clears bricks.
[*]Fixed a bug where the client fails to connect to the server if the username contains the '|' character.
[*]Partially fixed bug where move descriptions on the Character Select Scene fail to appear if you're playing on the right side in an Online Match.
[*]Fixed misc. server-related bugs.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]

[*] [b][u]Non-English Steam Names are not showing up since international font isn't supported yet[/u][/b] 
If an opponent leaves an Online Match due to being invited to a Private Match, you may get stuck.  Please restart the client if this happens

[*] [b][u]The Spaera Client still needs some performance tweaks and can get sluggish over time.[/u][/b] 
If this becomes an issue, please restart the client to fix it for now.

[*] [b][u]Panic text sometimes goes behind the board if it shows up during a magic spell.[/u][/b] 

[*] [b][u]There are still some unexpected graphical glitches here and there.[/u][/b] 
We fixed a few of them in this patch, but if you still see glitches old or new, please report them.  We'd like to make sure we don't miss any of them!
[/list]

As always, if new bugs are found, Please report them to the Steam Spaera Discussion Page!

notes.title: Spaera Balance Patch
notes.notes:
We are on our 4th patch cycle since the Early Access Release!  Thank you all for being patient with us as we continue to improve Spaera!

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b][u]Setter's "Setter Cannon" is Now a Level 2 Spell and"Blast Hurricane" is Now a Level 3 Spell[/u][/b]
We wanted Setter Z to have more attacking options so we decided to try moving his offensives spells into the lower tier.

[*] [b][u]Setter's "Setter Cannon" duration is reduced from 3 turns to 2[/u][/b]
As part of the change above, Setter Cannon's duration has been reduced to fit in terms of power as a Level 2 Spell.

[*] [b][u]Setter Z's "Blast Knuckle" slow effect reduced from previous patch[/u][/b]
Last patch we changed the way Blast Knuckle worked by having it also reduce the base drop speed.  It was a bit overpowered so we reduced the slow effect.

[*] [b][u]Harland's "Gas To Solid" Spell buffed to fill the whole bottom row[/u][/b]
This is a change we've wanted to do for a while as a slight buff to Harland.  It's not a game changer but the bonus attack blocks from the clear is welcomed.
[/list]

[h1]New Stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b][u]Character Specific Confirm Drop Particle Effects[/u][/b] 
Those who were part of Spaera's Beta1 probably remembers this little subtle spell effect.  Each character has their own special particle effects when using Confirm Drop!

[*] [b][u]New UI Assets Updated[/u][/b] 
As we get closer and closer to a final release, placeholder UI elements are getting properly populated and replaced!
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b][u]Resolution Change Bug Fixes[/u][/b] 
[*] [b][u]Screen Transition Bug Fixes[/u][/b] 
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b][u]Previously saved options will be reverted to the default settings[/u][/b] 
Apologies for the inconvenience, but this is a side-effect from the changing of the format for controls and options.

[*] [b][u]Non-English Steam Names are not showing up since international font isn't supported yet[/u][/b] 
If an opponent leaves an Online Match due to being invited to a Private Match, you may get stuck.  Please restart the client if this happens

[*] [b][u]The Spaera Client still needs some performance tweaks and can get sluggish over time.[/u][/b] 
If this becomes an issue, please restart the client to fix it for now.

[*] [b][u]There are still some unexpected graphical glitches here and there.[/u][/b] 
[/list]
If new bugs are found, Please report them to the Steam Spaera Discussion Page!

notes.title: Patch 0.9.2.3
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147106/64c6bdb3982466f0bfded8653f6854f05216d6e5.png[/img]
In this patch, we are adding the Leaderboards screen along with a few bug fixes.

[h1]Leaderboards[/h1]
Still a work in progress, it currently has two screens:
[olist]
[*] [b][u]The top players on the Leaderboard[/u][/b] 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147106/46c91de6563c7711cb6d2f349ba7c74c2d7ade5a.png[/img]
Currently only a handful of players are shown here, but expect to see this page being paginated in the future.

[*] [b][u]Your position on the Leaderboards and players near your rank[/u][/b] 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147106/020717ff7e75e3a81c68cd08fa87edce0010e717.png[/img]
This is also looking very vanilla at the moment, and we still need to add highlighting to indicate the row you're at.
[/olist]
[b][u]What to expect in the future[/u][/b] 
In the future, we will likely rename the button to something such as Social, and where you can look at your stats, as well as the stats of your friends, and players you've recently played against.


[h1]CPU Difficulty[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147106/e537c7539ed90dce1c642acffa2e07f6203aa2ce.png[/img]

So far, our CPU has made quite a few enemies out of players.  It's been terrorizing newcomers who are still getting acquainted with the system, while it feels too weak to more advanced players.

Before we add a difficulty toggle, which should happen in the coming weeks, we've decided to make the CPU play slower to welcome our new players.

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
